H1A-G0.evidence: Formation API accepts only Claim, Relation, SourceSpan and configuration; the run reports no forbidden formation imports or question-like CLI inputs.

H1A-G1.evidence: Reversing every input collection produces byte-identical seeds; removing one complete 22-Claim Source leaves all 83 unrelated modules byte-identical; a unit test also preserves an unrelated module across a local addition.

H1A-G2.evidence: 496/496 consumable Dev Claims formed into 86 materialized modules; all modules pass assertion-to-Claim-to-Evidence support inspection. Sixteen rejected Claims are all non-consumable lifecycle/publication records.

H1A-G3.evidence: Each module contains 2-8 assertions; complete deduplicated EvidenceSpan text is bounded by 4000 characters (observed maximum 244). Oversized single-Claim evidence is rejected explicitly.

H1A-G4.evidence: Known questions are read only by a separate post-hoc diagnostic after the formation directory exists; every run is immutable and earlier failed/misleading runs remain preserved.

devSignal.interpretation: Seed-anchored Wiki navigation and ranked atomic injection removed the observed stale-module overwrite and recovered one additional required Claim. This is mechanism evidence, not blind answer-quality evidence.

preservedLearning: h1a-dev-v1 silently lost singleton tails and is retained as a failed first design.
h1a-diagnostic-v6 showed a lower-ranked module evicting an already accepted higher-ranked closure; it is retained and fixed by ranked atomic ownership.
Wiki navigation is activated by reliable Claim seeds; it is not an independent default content stream.
The eight-assertion default aligns formation output with the ten-slot online consumer contract instead of optimizing a revealed question.
nextDecision: Run one new H1 held-out cycle under heldout-contract-v1.json. Do not tune on its questions or Gold, and do not claim product value before Stage B adjudication.
